markdown:
<title level="1" right="Hazard 2" pfs="">[Rusted Door](/Hazards.aspx?ID=419)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Trap" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=158" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rusthenge](/Sources.aspx?ID=215) pg. 32

**Complexity** Simple

</column>

Shards of rust extend from the door and crumble away to cling to the flesh and clothes of anyone who attempts to open or damage the door.

---

**Stealth**
DC 18 (trained)

**Disable**
DC 18 [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) to deface the hidden runes that allow the trap to activate, or DC 21 [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) to offer prayers to a non-evil deity to override the ancient influence of Xar-Azmak

<column gap="tiny">

**AC** 15, **Fort** +11, **Ref** +5

**Hardness**
8

**HP**
30 (BT 15)

**Immunities**
critical hits, object immunities, precision damage

</column>

**Inflict Rust Creep** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** A non-worshipper of Xar-Azmak attempts to open the door or causes damage to it with a melee Strike; **Effect** The triggering creature is exposed to [rust creep](/Diseases.aspx?ID=25) as tendrils of rust-red energy seem to slither out of the rusty patches on the door to rasp strangely gently against exposed skin.

---
**Reset**
The rusted door resets automatically after 1 round.

reset: The rusted door resets automatically after 1 round.
